problem: The live readiness compiler only accepts return.state containing RETURN plus run.state exactly DONE, while current /wc workers emit semantically terminal receipts with state/status DONE or COMPLETE. Valid completed dependencies therefore remain BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY and S2 integration readiness cannot be derived from the live receipts.
acceptance: Define one canonical terminal/return evidence contract or a preserve-first compatibility normalizer covering current emitted DONE, COMPLETE and RETURNED_* forms without treating failed, conflict, boundary or active runs as success.

Update readiness derivation and/or worker receipt emission so a real completed dependency set produces SATISFIED only from matched durable return plus terminal run evidence for the same opportunity/run.
Add regression fixtures from current Alumnos worker receipts and prove failed, conflicted, return-without-terminal and terminal-without-return cases still fail closed.

Exercise at least one live BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY successor to READY_DERIVED without editing its queue source status and persist an auditable receipt; no Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w promotion.
title: Normalize readiness receipt terminal semantics
mission: Repair the interoperability boundary between live /wc worker closure receipts and the dynamic-readiness compiler so dependency-gated work can become READY_DERIVED from real durable evidence while preserving fail-closed behavior and authority separation.

unblock_value.reason: Dependency-gated S2 local integrations cannot be derived ready when semantically completed live receipts do not satisfy the compiler's narrower state vocabulary.

incident_repair.reason: The Alumnos dependency set exposes a concrete live interoperability failure between worker-emitted terminal schemas and the readiness evidence classifier.

regression_prevention.reason: A canonical compatibility contract plus fixtures can keep failed/conflicted/incomplete dependencies fail-closed while preventing future terminal-schema drift from silently blocking convergence.

goal_relevance.reason: The /wc canary explicitly requires dynamic readiness, durable RETURNs and autonomous re-entry without queue-source mutation or manual orchestration.

falsification: A current semantically completed dependency pair still classifies as unsatisfied solely because one producer uses DONE/COMPLETE rather than RETURNED_*/DONE vocabulary.
The compatibility repair causes FAILED, CONFLICT, BOUNDARY, active, return-without-terminal or terminal-without-return evidence to classify as SATISFIED.
A READY_DERIVED transition requires editing the queue source status rather than being computed from evidence.
The repair promotes Current, Human Accepted, Served, production /w or any product authority.
dedup_note: Inspected the live universal queue, claims, current Alumnos dependency returns, the dynamic-readiness compiler and discovery proposals. The dynamic-readiness implementation itself is already claimed/returned and should not be overwritten; this proposal isolates the newly observed producer-consumer terminal-schema interoperability defect rather than duplicating that completed build lane.
